subject: MAP draft: NexaHealth SDK & streaming integration milestones
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@nexahealth.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (SDK + streaming milestones)

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our call, I’m attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the Integration Build milestone (SDK integration, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs). Key items below — please review and confirm owners/target dates so we can lock the MAP and progress to a technical PoC.

Quick recap (what we discussed):
- Redwood will provide an SDK + sample streaming client for event ingestion and tool-calling flows.
- Nexa will validate structured-output schema for clinical-summary and annotations.
- Target: PoC integration and performance validation in a staging environment, followed by pilot in PROD.

Proposed high-level milestones (see attached Nexa_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf for full detail):
1) 09/07 — SDK kickstart: onboarding, API keys, initial sample integration (owner: Jonas).
2) 09/14 — Streaming PoC: end-to-end streaming with KV cache enabled (owner: Marissa).
3) 09/21 — Tool-calling & structured outputs confirmation: schema sign-off, tool integration (owner: Vivek).
4) 09/28 — Pilot readiness: performance and security checklist, procurement sign-off (owner: Nexa procurement).

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- EHR connector / data feed contract (Nexa / EHR vendor).
- API key provisioning and staging VPC access for Redwood.
- SOC2 evidence & privacy checklist for procurement.

Action items for this thread: please reply with: 1) confirmation or alternate owners for each milestone, 2) any missing dependencies, and 3) whether target close date 2026-09-30 is achievable.

Attachments: Nexa_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf), sdk_integration_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP once we have confirmations and share a link to the live doc.

— Jonas

Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-09-01T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (SDK + streaming milestones)

Thanks Jonas — helpful recap. A few notes from our side: 

1) Owners:
- SDK kickstart — Emily (Nexa) to coordinate with IT for API key request (will confirm by 09/03).
- Streaming PoC — Tom will own the technical run and validate throughput.
- Structured outputs/schema — Clinical informatics (CC: procurement looped for timeline).

2) Question on structured outputs: the clinical-summary schema will need a delta field for manual edits (so our downstream auditing can reconcile). Can Redwood confirm whether structured outputs support a change-tracking field and the expected payload size?

3) Procurement: procurement@nexahealth.com — they require SOC2 evidence and a deployment diagram before pilot approval.

Target close date: 2026-09-30 is aggressive but possible if dependencies are met — Tom and I will confirm the EHR connector timing (this is the gating item).

Attachment: requirements_export.csv (CSV) — includes our expected fields for structured outputs.

Emily
Emily Cho | Head of Integrations, NexaHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@nexahealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (SDK + streaming milestones) — technical note

Emily / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. A few technical clarifications and commitments from Redwood so Nexa can map tasks on your side: 

- Structured outputs: Redwood supports a revision metadata block (revision_id, changed_by, changed_at) in the structured output envelope. We’ll include a small change_delta field (text) and an array of change events for audit — payload overhead is typically < 2kb per document for the clinical-summary use case.

- Streaming PoC: streaming client (ws/gRPC) will be provided. For throughput validation we recommend starting with a 100 req/sec load test in staging; we’ll provide tooling and a sample harness.

- Tool-calling: we support synchronous tool calls and async callback hooks. For the MAP, suggested owner assignments and deadlines: 
  * SDK kickstart (Jonas) — deliverables: sample client, onboarding doc, API key instructions — target 2026-09-07.
  * Streaming PoC (Marissa) — deliverables: sample harness, runbook, perf report — target 2026-09-14.
  * Tool-calling & structured outputs (Vivek + Priya) — deliverables: schema v1, tool adapter examples, test suite — target 2026-09-21.
  * Pilot readiness (Nexa procurement & IT) — deliverables: SOC2 artifacts, deployment diagram, access approvals — target 2026-09-28.

Dependencies / risks: 
- If EHR vendor cannot provide test feed by 09/10, PoC timeline will slide by ~2 weeks.
- Region-specific deployment: Nexa requested US-east region; we need staging VPC peering set up (Nexa IT).

I’ll update the MAP PDF and the shared Drive doc with these owner assignments and add a checklist for SOC2 artifacts. Proposed next step: schedule a 30-minute MAP alignment call on 2026-09-04 (Jonas, Marissa, Tom, Emily, Vivek).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Li <tom.li@nexahealth.com>

Date: 2026-09-02T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (SDK + streaming milestones) — EHR dependency

Marissa / team —

Quick confirmation from engineering: we can run the streaming PoC once the EHR vendor provides a read-only test feed. Estimated delivery from vendor: 09/09 (tentative). Also, one dependency we did not cover — our EHR contract has a data transformation clause. We’ll need Redwood to sign an addendum or provide a letter of assurance about no persistent storage of PHI in your logs for the PoC. Procurement is CC’d.

Can you include the exact endpoints (staging) and the expected auth header format? If we can get that this week, we’ll start provisioning.

— Tom
